name: minimize_multiple_elements
description: Every element of a #minimize statement carries its own weight, discriminant, condition and level. Here q(1) pays 2 while p(2) and p(3) pay 1 each, so level 1 costs 4. Reading only the first element of the statement (and joining every element's condition into a single body) used to report a cost of 0 and hide the second element from the optimality summary.
